design_brief.aesthetic: Immersive arcade-fire adventure, preserving the supplied game's full-screen 3D presentation exactly rather than wrapping it in new shell UI
design_brief.colors: Preserve the supplied palette exactly: ember-black #140806, flame orange #ff7a2e, hot red #e8352c, gold #ffd76a, and warm off-white highlights
design_brief.hero_element: The supplied full-screen 3D game canvas and its existing title/mode overlay
design_brief.moment: A player opens the big Fire Babys update on a phone and immediately enters the six-biome 3D world, chooses a mode, and walks into monster encounters while progress saves locally
design_brief.typography: Preserve the supplied system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto stack embedded in the game file
